question: Should the agent activity timeline ship as a standalone surface now, or should maintainers first make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38626 the canonical audit/lifecycle foundation for it?
rationale: The source has useful live and trajectory primitives, but persistence owner, event taxonomy, authorization, redaction, retention, and UI placement require product/security intent before implementation.

options.title: Design foundation first
options.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger and subagent lifecycle receipt contracts as the canonical source, then add the timeline CLI/chat/TUI/export surface on top.

options.title: Build timeline directly
options.body: Implement this issue as a standalone product surface now, accepting the risk of parallel lifecycle or audit semantics.

options.title: Decline core timeline
options.body: Keep Activity, trajectory export, and subagent list surfaces as the supported observability path for now.

recommendation.title: Design foundation first
recommendation.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger and subagent lifecycle receipt contracts as the canonical source, then add the timeline CLI/chat/TUI/export surface on top.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the related metadata-audit direction and appears in adjacent state/lifecycle history.
